subject: Scheduling data access window for SIG probes & sample log exports
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Monroe <alex@clearwave.io>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG probe windows and sample logs request

Hi David —

Thanks again for taking this on. To move the SIG review forward our security team needs two things from Redwood: a 2-hour data access window to run live probes against the logging endpoint, and a set of representative application logs for the past 30 days (redacted where necessary). The compliance gate is next Thursday and we need both items by end of day Wednesday for the review board.

Can you confirm:
- Which days next week you can open an access window (we prefer Monday–Wednesday mornings PST)
- Who will be the point of contact for the log export and any clarifications on redaction
- Whether there are any constraints on sample size or time range for export (we're OK with a 24–48 hour sample slice if 30 days is heavy)

Appreciate it — Priya

--
Priya Shah
Senior Security Program Manager | Acme Health
priya@acmehealth.com
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Monroe <alex@clearwave.io>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG probe windows and sample logs request

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can do a 2-hour access window and provide representative logs. Proposed plan: 

- Access window: Tuesday 2026-08-11, 08:00–10:00 PST (our ops team will stand by)
- Sample logs: full 48-hour slice from 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-22 (compressed, with PII redaction applied by default)
- POC: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com) for the log export and Hannah Schmitt for evidence mapping and redaction rules

We will attach the initial scope workbook (sig_probe_scope_v1.xlsx) with the fields we intend to export. If you need a larger window or a different date range, let us know.

Action items I’ve taken:
1) Marissa: confirm export feasibility and estimated upload time
2) Hannah: define redaction template and list of fields that will be masked before delivery
3) Ops: provision temporary read-only credentials for ClearWave probes during the window

I’ll follow up once Marissa confirms the export file size and an upload destination.

-David

--
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG probe windows and sample logs request

Quick follow-up on feasibility:

- 48-hour compressed export looks good. Estimated size ~2.8GB (JSON-lines). We can run a filter to restrict to request/response headers and auth events if you want a smaller slice — that drops it to ~450MB.
- Upload options: secure S3 presigned URL (preferred) or direct upload to your vendor portal (ClearWave).
- Retention/cleanup: we will delete the export from our staging bucket 48 hours after successful handoff; we can provide an S3 lifecycle confirmation email as evidence.

Let us know if you want the heavier export; otherwise we'll prepare the 48-hour export with default redactions and push to a presigned URL.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG probe windows and sample logs request

Priya —

On redaction: our standard template replaces all 1) user identifiers (emails/SSNs) with hashed tokens, 2) client IPs with /24 masked blocks, and 3) session tokens with fixed placeholders. For the board review, we can also provide a short doc describing the redaction algorithm and the deterministic salt used for hashes (we don’t publish the salt but can attest to its use).

If Acme requires a fully anonymized sample (no deterministic hashes), flag that now — it will add ~1 business day to prep time.

Also note: the probes will be read-only and rate-limited to preserve production SLOs; they will be executed by the ClearWave team under our temporary creds.

-Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Shah <priya@acmehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Monroe <alex@clearwave.io>
Date: 2026-08-06T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG probe windows and sample logs request

Thanks — that plan works. Two quick asks before you proceed:

1) Please send the presigned S3 URL and an MD5 checksum for the upload so our intake team can verify integrity.
2) Could you attach the scope workbook (sig_probe_scope_v1.xlsx) with the specific fields mapped to SIG questions? That will speed the board review.

We prefer the 48-hour export unless you believe the reduced request/response-only slice is better for inspection. Also please confirm you will delete the export from staging within 48 hours post-handoff.

If you can get the upload link and the workbook to me by EOD tomorrow (2026-08-07), we’ll schedule the probe for Tuesday morning as proposed.

Appreciate the coordination — Priya

--
Priya Shah
Senior Security Program Manager | Acme Health
priya@acmehealth.com
